text: dragDropOverwriteMode : bool Qt 5 reference:
title: PythonQt.QtGui.QAbstractItemView.dragDropOverwriteMode

text: This property holds the view's drag and drop behavior If its value is true , the selected data will overwrite the existing item data when dropped, while moving the data will clear the item. If its value is false , the selected data will be inserted as a new item when the data is dropped. When the data is moved, the item is removed as well. The default value is false , as in the QListView and QTreeView subclasses. In the QTableView subclass, on the other hand, the property has been set to true . Note: This is not intended to prevent overwriting of items. The model's implementation of flags() should do that by not returning Qt::ItemIsDropEnabled . This property was introduced in Qt 4.2. The given widget 's autoFillBackground property must be set to true, otherwise the widget's background will be transparent, showing both the model data and the item at the given index .
